causalFinding.fact: The registered JSON Schema is valid under general JSON Schema const semantics but is outside the stricter structured-output subset accepted by the Codex service because targetCommit lacks an explicit type.
causalFinding.inference: Repository registration shape validation and prompt-visible capability preflight do not establish host acceptance of a task-specific structured-output schema. A task can therefore pass G4 and still fail before measured model behavior.
causalFinding.correction: Do not edit or retry this registration. A future materially different task must pre-register a host-supported schema with explicit types on every property and bind a deterministic compatibility check or an independently fixed known-supported schema before its one allowed call. Do not generalize this task-specific defect into a receipt ecosystem, model runtime, or outcome validator.
